name: Create a New Release for an Organization
description: Create a New Release for an Organization Create a new release for the given organization. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/
Create a new release for the given organization. Releases are used by Sentry to improve error reporting by correlating first-seen events with the release that may have introduced them, and are required for source maps and other debug features. Release versions that are the same across multiple projects within an organization are treated as the same release in Sentry.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Retrieve an Organization's Release
description: Retrieve an Organization's Release Return details on an individual release. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/
Return details on an individual release.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; version (path) — The version identifier of the release
Optional: project_id (query) — Deprecated. Use project instead.; project (query) — The project ID or slug to filter by. Overrides project_id when both are sent.; health (query) — Whether or not to include health data with the release. By default, this is false.; adoptionStages (query) — Whether or not to include adoption stages with the release. By default, this is false.; summaryStatsPeriod (query) — The period of time used to query summary stats for the release. By default, this is 14d.; healthStatsPeriod (query) — The period of time used to query health stats for the release. By default, this is 24h if health is enabled.; sort (query) — The field used to sort results by. By default, this is `date`.; status (query) — Release statuses that you can filter by.; query (query) — Filters results by using [query syntax](/product/sentry-basics/search/). Example: `query=(transaction:foo AND release:abc) OR (transaction:[bar,baz] AND release:def)`

name: Retrieve an Organization Release's File
description: Retrieve an Organization Release's File Return metadata for an individual file within a release. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/files/{file_id}/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/files/{file_id}/
Return metadata for an individual file within a release. Does not return the file contents unless `download` is set.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; version (path) — The version identifier of the release; file_id (path) — The ID of the release file.
Optional: download (query) — If set, download the file contents instead of returning metadata.

name: List an Organization's Releases
description: List an Organization's Releases Return a list of releases for a given organization, sorted by most recent. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/
Return a list of releases for a given organization, sorted by most recent.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: project (query) — The IDs or slugs of projects to filter by. Project slugs are unique within each organization. Omit this parameter to include all accessible projects. `-1` is also accepted to include all accessible projects. For example, the following are valid parameters: - `/?project=1234&project=56789` - `/?project=android&project=javascript-react` - `/?project=-1`; environment (query) — The name of environments to filter by.; query (query) — Case-insensitive substring match against the release version.; per_page (query) — Limit the number of rows to return in the result. Default and maximum allowed is 100.; cursor (query) — A pointer to the last object fetched and its sort order; used to retrieve the next or previous results.

name: Upload a New Organization Release File
description: Upload a New Organization Release File Upload a new file for the given release. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/files/
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/releases/{version}/files/
Upload a new file for the given release. Files must be uploaded using the `multipart/form-data` content type, against the region-specific domain (e.g. `us.sentry.io` or `de.sentry.io`).
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; version (path) — The version identifier of the release; body (body)
